messages:
alex_dev: anyone else seeing a spike in 401s for hosted API? started around 09:12 UTC. customers reporting auth failures across regions. /v1/generate returning 401s intermittently. :rotating_light:

mira_sre: yep seeing it in telemetry dashboards. auth-service latency also up ~3x. throwing token introspect errors. digging into rotation jobs now.

sam_support: getting slack threads from multiple customers — some say SSO logins failing as well (error: invalid_token). raising priority with support.

jordan_prod: confirmed — synthetic checks started failing at 09:11:43. rolling 5min error rate -> 22%.

mira_sre: quick snapshot of logs from auth-introspect:```
level=error service=auth-introspect msg="token validation failed" err="kid mismatch" jwks_version=4 request_id=rid_8a2f
``` looks like JWKS rotation happened but verification service still had old key cached.

alex_dev: that fits with the rotation job kicked at 09:10 by key-rotation-runner. Did the job complete?

mira_sre: job appears to have partially succeeded — new JWKS committed to control-plane DB, but memcached fronting the verification cluster had stale entries. some nodes saw new key, others still on v3. token signatures (signed with v3) are failing against nodes expecting v4 KID.

liz_security: that should be symmetric though — either verifying nodes accept both or signing service should sign with new kid. any evidence signing service used old/new?

mira_sre: signing-service logs show rotation started then retried due to timeout:```
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z signing svc rotation start id=rot_342
2026-03-15T09:10:18Z signing svc rotation apply timeout error: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T09:10:18Z signing svc rotation fallback to v3 id=rot_342
``` so looks like signing service rolled back locally but control plane state moved to v4 — inconsistent state.

beth_prod: so control-plane says v4, signing-service used v3, verify-nodes some v3 some v4 -> kid mismatch = 401.

ops-oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) revert control-plane JWKS to v3, 2) force signing-service to v4 (risky), 3) add dual-key acceptance on verify layer. fastest is revert control-plane to v3.

alex_dev: agree revert control-plane. is there an admin API?

mira_sre: yes — /admin/jwks/revert. doing `curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/admin/jwks/revert -d '{"version":3}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"` now. will follow up once applied.

deploy-bot: deploy started: control-plane-jwks-revert v1 -> running on k8s/auth-controlplane cluster (pod jwks-prop-12).

mira_sre: revert accepted, restarting jwks-propagator to flush caches. also purging memcache keys for jwks: `mc-purge --prefix jwks:v*`.

jordan_prod: after revert, synthetic checks beginning to pass again. error rate down to ~2% within 60s.

sam_support: messaging to affected customers drafted. pushing update to status.redwood.ai with incident notice and ETA for postmortem.

liz_security: any evidence of tokens being revoked/issued incorrectly? we should check if any tokens signed with v4 were issued during the window — those might be rejected until re-signed or rotated.

mira_sre: good point. token issuance logs: we signed ~1200 tokens with v4 between 09:10:12 and 09:10:18 before the signing svc fallback. We'll generate a short-lived policy to accept both kids in the verify layer for 10 minutes as additional buffer while we reconcile.

ops-oncall: created temporary allowlist to accept v3 and v4 kids in verify cluster: `/ops/config/verify.accept_kids=[3,4]`. pushing now.

deploy-bot: config rollout complete to verify-nodes across us/eu regions (3 zones).

alex_dev: confirm auth errors resolved for customers? any remaining accounts affected?

sam_support: triaging open tickets — ~7 customers reported persistent 401s after revert, most resolved after the dual-kid accept. reaching out to those still failing for logs.

beth_prod: next steps for RCA: 1) make rotation job transactional across control-plane + signing service 2) ensure memcache TTLs and propagator hooks during rotation 3) postmortem and customer notes.

liz_security: add a check in rotation workflow to validate signing-service ack before control-plane commit. and include canary rollout: update 1 signing node, wait healthcheck, then proceed.

mira_sre: creating incident ticket with timeline. will own the PM for the postmortem. putting blockers in product-backlog.

sam_support: status update posted to status page and flagged billing team to watch for any billing anomalies tied to retries.

alex_dev: thanks team. root cause seems to be non-atomic JWKS rotation + caching layers not invalidated properly.

ops-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. keeping channel open for 1hr for follow-ups.

jordan_prod: adding action item: add e2e test for jwks rotate that simulates partial failure.

beth_prod: customer comms: follow-up email template ready, will send to affected customers with apology, mitigation, and upcoming fixes.

mira_sre: final notes: total impact window ~09:10:12 - 09:14:02 UTC. estimated affected requests ~18k, ~1.8k failed. scheduling postmortem doc and will share within 48h. :white_check_mark:
